name: Yokai: Lust Secret 🪭
source:
Yokai: Lust Secret is an adult visual novel set in a mysterious Asian folklore world. Strange events, eerie encounters, and seductive yokai blur the line between reality and illusion. Uncover the truth before you’re pulled too deep.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533730/Yokai_Lust_Secret/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《妖怪：情欲秘闻》是一部以神秘东方民俗怪谈世界为舞台的成人视觉小说。离奇诡谲的事件、毛骨悚然的邂逅，以及妖娆魅惑的妖怪们模糊了现实与幻境的界限。赶在自己陷得太深、无法自拔之前揭开真相吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533730/Yokai_Lust_Secret/]Steam[/url]]
